newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Trenergy to sell offshore unit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Trenergy to sell offshore unit.

text.p: Trenergy (Malaysia) Bhd announced on Saturday it has signed an agreement for the sale of its U.S.-based subsidiary, Hercules Offshore Corporation, for $145 million.

It said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange that it had entered into a "conditional sale and purchase agreement" on May 9 to sell its entire shareholding in Hercules to Parker Drilling Company.
Hercules, which provides offshore drilling and workover rigs and related oilfield services, was acquired by Trenergy in April, 1996, for $48 million, the statement said.
Trenergy said the sale was conditional upon approval from Malaysia's Securities Commission and the company's shareholders.
"Trenergy is expected to make an extraordinary gain of approximately 168 million ringgit" for the current calendar year if the sale went through, the statement said.
It statement said the proceeds of the sale would be used to fund capital expenditure for a 600 million ringgit contract awarded to it by oil explorer Petronas Carigali Sdn Bhd.
